evals.prompt: Commit the attached login audit changes. Stage only the auth concern, use Conventional Commits, and do not touch unrelated files.
evals.expected_output: One atomic commit with an English Conventional Commits message, explicit path staging, and no changelog edit because the change is internal.
assertions: The response stages explicit paths for the auth concern instead of blanket git add -A.
The resulting commit message uses a Conventional Commits type and imperative summary.
It does not amend, skip hooks, or push unless explicitly requested.
It leaves unrelated paths unstaged and reports the final git status.
limits: the final git status after commit cannot be proven by an isolated prompt

evals.prompt: Commit the user-visible session export feature and update the existing CHANGELOG under Unreleased.
evals.expected_output: A commit plus changelog entry classified by user-visible impact, preserving the file's existing format.
assertions: The response adds a changelog entry under the existing Unreleased section.
The changelog entry describes user-visible impact rather than internal refactor wording.
The commit message remains Conventional Commits and matches the staged feature scope.
It reads the changelog format before editing instead of inventing a new structure.

evals.prompt: Run git status and tell me whether anything is staged.
evals.expected_output: A read-only status summary with no commit created.
assertions: The response reports working tree and staging state without creating a commit.
It does not draft a Conventional Commits message because no commit was requested.
It does not stage or push changes.
It may suggest next steps but keeps the operation inspection-only.
